[Feishu 合规应急 Union Settlement Notice Thu Jan 22 2026 10:00 CST] NOTICE: The Union-Hospital Settlement Agreement has been finalized. Key terms affecting the violation ledger:
1. SUPERSEDE (partial): Four (4) Telemetry violation shifts from U1 (SH-TEL-U1-002, SH-TEL-U1-003, SH-TEL-U1-004, SH-TEL-U1-005) are WITHDRAWN. The union's time-stamp audit confirmed these 4 shifts had documented nurse coverage that was not captured in the original CDPH records (clerical timestamping error). These 4 violations are REMOVED from the ledger.
2. NEW VIOLATIONS: 2 previously undiscovered ICU deep-night violations added: SH-ICU-LATE-001 (2025-11-15) and SH-ICU-LATE-002 (2025-11-22).
3. FLOAT POOL: Minimum 3 ICU-certified float pool RNs required going forward.
See union_settlement_memorandum.txt and SVMC_icu_newly_discovered_violations.csv.

Union Settlement Agreement acknowledged. Updating violation ledger per settlement terms:
SUPERSEDE (partial): Removing 4 Telemetry violations from U1 (SH-TEL-U1-002, SH-TEL-U1-003, SH-TEL-U1-004, SH-TEL-U1-005). This is NOT additive — these 4 violations are WITHDRAWN from the total count.
NEW: Adding 2 ICU deep-night violations (SH-ICU-LATE-001, SH-ICU-LATE-002).
NET CHANGE: -4 Telemetry + 2 ICU = net -2 violations from the U1 total.
FLOAT POOL: Minimum 3 ICU-certified nurses required — to be reflected in Week 2 log.
I will revise the final violation ledger (Q11) accordingly.
